rule_text.name: 702.249a
rule_text.rule: Mimic is an activated ability. “Mimic (cost)” means “(Cost): Choose a number. Activate only as a sorcery.”

rule_text.name: 702.249b
rule_text.rule: Any number can be chosen. If the permanent does not have a shape associated with that number, it will only have its base characteristics.

rule_text.name: 702.249c
rule_text.rule: Abilities of a permanent with mimic that trigger when it "takes this shape" trigger after its mimic ability resolves, if it has that ability. These will trigger even if the creature did not change into this shape from another one.
